cleaner.label: Gradle (Java, Kotlin, Android)
cleaner.description: Caches, distributions, native libraries, JDKs and daemon logs in the Gradle user folder. Does not touch gradle.properties, the init.d scripts or projects.

option.label: Gradle cache
option.description: Removes downloaded dependencies, build caches and compiled scripts in the caches folder.
option.warning: Stop the daemons with `gradle --stop` and close IDEs before cleaning. Dependencies and plugins are re-downloaded and scripts recompiled on the next build: the first one will be slow and needs the network.

option.label: Gradle wrapper distributions
option.description: Removes the Gradle versions downloaded by gradlew.

option.label: Gradle native libraries
option.description: Removes the native libraries Gradle extracts to interact with Windows.

option.label: JDKs downloaded by Gradle
option.description: Removes the JDKs downloaded by Gradle's toolchain support.
option.warning: Re-downloaded on the next build that needs them. If an IDE uses one of these JDKs, it must be reconfigured.

option.label: Gradle daemon logs
option.description: Removes the daemon-PID.out.log files in the daemon\version folders.
